description: Typodeck visual-design research record. One JSON object per record; collections are stored as JSONL (one record per line). Quality gates: verifiable source_url required, no duplicate source_url across the corpus, no fabricated visuals (visual_inspection_status must be honest), unknown stays unknown (use "unknown"/null, never guess).

category.description: Design category of the researched artifact.

composition_analysis.description: Structured composition analysis. All claims must derive from the inspected source or be marked unknown.

primitives.description: Composition primitives observed (Typodeck grammar names preferred; free-form allowed with 'other:' prefix).

reading_order.description: Observed reading order / eye path, or 'unknown'.

evidence_confidence.description: Confidence in transferability to slides (matches research/typography/evidence-registry.json legend).

limitations.description: Transfer limitations / what does NOT apply to slides.

originality_notes.description: What is novel vs already-covered in the Typodeck grammar, or 'unknown'.

required_engine_capabilities.description: Engine capabilities needed to render this on slides. Known grammar primitives preferred; genuinely new needs use 'new:' prefix.

slide_adaptability.description: How well the design transfers to typography-only 16:9 slides.

source_url.description: Verifiable source URL (http/https). REQUIRED — no record without one.

typographic_techniques.description: Typographic techniques observed (tracking, scale contrast, rag, etc.).

visual_inspection_status.description: Honest inspection status. 'inspected-primary' = saw the artifact itself; never claim inspection you did not do.

whitespace_strategy.description: How whitespace/negative space is used, or 'unknown'.

year.description: Year of the artifact, or null when unknown (never guess).

title: TypodeckResearchRecord
